Discrepancies in findings seemingly can be explained by differences in regional hypertrophy that are routinely seen in the quadriceps across training studies (8, 66, 67). Additionally, extended field-of-view ultrasound imaging showed high agreement with MRI in detecting changes in muscle cross-sectional area (ICC = .929, SEM = .94 cm 2 ) over the course of a 21-week resistance training program (4).
